title: Area 51 programs moved to Dugway Proving Ground
place_text: Dugway Proving Ground, Utah; Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: And he always quotes that 35 to 40% of programs at Area 51 were moved to Dougway in Utah. Well, if you look at ah's testimony in 2000, the year 2000 recorded, he says the exact same thing.

plain: About 35 to 40 percent of the secret programs at Area 51, the highly secret Air Force test site in Nevada, are said to have moved to Dugway Proving Ground, an Army testing range in Utah. A researcher who goes online by the name UAPGerb points out that Steven Greer, a well-known UFO activist, often repeats that figure, and that an anonymous witness known only as "AH" said "the exact same thing" in recorded testimony from 2000, kept in an archive of witness interviews. If true, much of the secret work people link to Area 51 would now be done in Utah.
